description: For a snapshot, a forward-only and a table-type recordset over F in turn: assign Filter "N > 20", assign Sort "N DESC", read both, call OpenRecordset() with no arguments into a derived recordset, read its Type, Filter and Sort and walk ID to EOF; walk ID on the source from its first row. Asks which types accept Filter and Sort and what the derived recordset of each holds. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
